title: XML External Entity Processing in DocumentBuilder
platform_conditions: Java SE 8+ (JAXP); the factory defaults differ across JDK releases and container configurations, so the effective settings must be read from code
security_mechanism: DocumentBuilderFactory, SAXParserFactory, XMLInputFactory, and TransformerFactory are created with defaults that historically keep DTD processing and external entity resolution enabled: without an explicit setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true) or a null-resolver/attribute set, an attacker-supplied DOCTYPE resolves entities to file:// or http:// targets and the parser inlines the fetched content into the document (local file read, SSRF, and echoed output). Recursive internal entities produce billion-laughs memory expansion independent of external resolution. The relevant setting lives on the factory, so a secure default in one helper does not protect a second factory created elsewhere in the same application.

source_sink_clues.source: XML documents from clients: SOAP/REST payloads, SAML assertions, uploaded configuration and integration files, webhooks posting XML.
source_sink_clues.sink: DocumentBuilder.parse / SAXParser.parse / XMLStreamReader (XMLInputFactory-created) / Transformer.transform on untrusted documents where the corresponding factory lacks disallow-doctype-decl, external-general-entities, and external-parameter-entities protections

tracking_guards: Check the factory configuration BEFORE parse: setFeature(disallow-doctype-decl, true) or, where DTDs are required, setFeature for external-general/parameter-entities false plus setXIncludeAware(false) and an expansion limit; verify every factory instance in the request path carries the settings, not just one.
not_candidate_when: Doctype declarations are prohibited on every factory handling untrusted documents, the XML comes from a trusted internal producer with no DTD by construction, or schema validation with a fixed XSD rejects documents containing DTDs before entity processing.
public_references: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/611.html
CWE-776: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/776.html
OWASP XML External Entity Prevention Cheat Sheet — https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/XML_External_Entity_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html
